## Où j'en suis
Work on the dashboards v2 grid (branch tom/dashboard-grid-v2) is done and pushed as draft PR kestrel-analytics/platform#418: react-grid-layout drag/resize, layout persisted server-side via `PUT /dashboards/:id/layout` (localStorage fallback), widget sizing via ResizeObserver, DashboardTile renamed to WidgetCard, storybook build fixed. Awaiting UX review before the Zest demo on Tuesday Nov 24.

- [en-cours] Draft PR #418 open, last commit d2286a0; Priya's UX review on iPad (iOS 15) not yet done.
- [prochaine-étape] Priya reviews UX on BrowserStack iPad; enable dashboards_v2 flag for Zest workspace only (flags admin, no code change).
- [prochaine-étape] Zest demo of new dashboards is Tuesday the 24th; v1 dashboards stay behind the flag until January (comment in DashboardPage).
- [essai-raté] Container queries for widget sizing: ignored by iOS 15 Safari (needs Safari 16+); replaced by a ResizeObserver hook (0b9f4e2).
- [essai-raté] DashboardGrid snapshot test failed after adding react-grid-layout wrappers; fixed by updating snapshots with `-u`.
- [décision] Drop container queries entirely, use only the useWidgetSize hook (source: t09).
- [décision] Flag on only for Zest's workspace, nothing removed until January, PR as draft (source: t15, t17).
